title: New update is out.
body: Everything should run a lot better now.
notes: Fixed a bunch of issues behind the scenes

title: Library Update
summary: I added more than 2000+ games into Vision.
body: The launcher now includes a huge new wave of games, with more than 2000+ added into the library.
Everything was rebuilt into the current launcher so the list stays in one place and is easier to search through.

title: Vision Update
summary: Recently, both of our websites have been taken down - Google Sites, and now Canvas. But this isn't the end.
body: This is just the upgraded version of Vision 1.0 and 2.0 combined. More features, more games, and way more access to things we couldn't even fit into the old sites.
No matter how many times things get removed or blocked, it just pushes us to build smarter, stronger, and better than before.
